description: The waiter's give-up runs from its own start, not the current holder's stamp, so holders taking turns ahead of it outlast it
One stamp per hold, written before its first call only, so a hold with two slow calls outlasts the waiter

description: A Keychain call outlives the stamp written before it: its own timeout is longer than the Budget waiters allow
The waiter measures on the real clock, which jumps across a laptop sleep while the holder's awake-clock stamps stand still
No slack: the waiter gives up the moment a call's budget ends, before the cut call has released the lock
